_: Home screen walkers: each player look's walk cycle on a sheet in resources/player sprites. region: the sprites are found inside it (x0, y0, x1, y1); grid: fixed cells (x0, y0, pitch x, pitch y, w, h). n frames per direction; order: which direction each row is (d u l r; a missing r mirrors l); cols: the sheet runs directions across columns instead. alias: looks without a sheet borrow another's. The player looks are Red and Leaf only for now (the owner's rule); the other heroes are kept in later/later_alias, switched off: move them back into walkers/alias (and AVATARS in a9a_screens.js) to bring them back. Lucas and Dawn's region now takes in their whole 4 x 4 block (it used to stop at 128 px, cutting off their bottom row). The owner renamed the sheets ("Pokemon Trainer <name>.png"); the later entries still have the old names, so check each sheet and its region when bringing it back.
